ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
